about: Bosses (v2.0.0, creator: players report the middle of a match gets boring with nobody to fight yet; 'A boss icon on the minimap; bosses drop their own custom loot'). Each match has a few (match sheet bosses), each guarding its lair somewhere on the island: a bigger Roblox avatar (scale) in its own outfit (Locker items, 'slot:id,...'), with a lot of health, a mythic gun (weapon, rarity) and a bot's aim (accuracy, reactionTicks); it fights anyone who comes within bossAggro blocks and never strays more than bossLeash from its lair. Everyone sees bosses on the minimap and the map. Not a player: it doesn't count towards players left. Eliminated, it drops its gun with ammo and its loot ('item:count+...', consumables sheet ids), and whoever eliminated it gets goldBoss gold.
